_description: Wallet HD derivation pinned across implementations (docs/spec.md 'Network Configuration'; docs/guides/CLIENT_CONVENTIONS.md §9). Each vector maps a 24-word BIP39 mnemonic (generated from the entropy named, e.g. entropy-zero = 32 × 0x00) to its account address derived at the chain path m/44'/9733'/0'/0/0 with an empty BIP39 passphrase. wrong_address_cosmoshub is the SAME mnemonic derived at cosmjs's default m/44'/118'/0'/0/0 (Cosmos Hub): implementations assert their derived address does NOT equal it, so a regression to the library default fails with a recognisable message rather than an opaque mismatch. Asserted by app/wallet_derivation_test.go (chain keyring) and typescript-sdk wallet.test.ts. Append-only, same regime as the crypto corpora.
